Components/Breadcrumb

Breadcrumb

Navigation breadcrumbs that show the current page location within a hierarchy.

Import

import { Breadcrumb } from 'mksystems';

Example

HomeComponentsBreadcrumb
<Breadcrumb
  items={[
    { label: "Home", href: "/" },
    { label: "Components", href: "/docs/components" },
    { label: "Breadcrumb" },
  ]}
/>

With Links

DashboardSettingsProfile
<Breadcrumb
  separator="/"
  items={[
    { label: "Dashboard", href: "/dashboard" },
    { label: "Settings", href: "/dashboard/settings" },
    { label: "Profile" },
  ]}
/>

Props

PropTypeDefaultDescription
items{ label: string; href?: string }[]—Array of breadcrumb items
separatorReactNode"/"Separator between items
classNamestring—Additional CSS classes
